dialogue.subtitle: Look at this geometric hellscape. We're flat vectors trapped in a 9:16 aspect ratio.
Speak for yourself. I minted my lack of depth as an NFT and sold it to Saudi princes.
Boomer tech. I trade human teeth on the dark web using a pigeon-hosted blockchain.
Just like when I tried to unionize the procedurally generated background NPCs.
CUTAWAY 1: Stick figures with picket signs beaten by a Google exec swinging a server rack.
Wow, a cutaway gag about late-stage capitalism. You're practically an indie developer now.
Better than Triangle's parasocial cult. He convinced kids to drink battery acid for engagement.

A sponsored integration! It cleanse

[PLACEHOLDER - TODO: fill this section in]

s the microplastics! Do you hate free speech?
Reminds me of when the algorithm decided empathy violated terms of service.
CUTAWAY 2: Smart-fridge threatening to leak search history unless restocked with premium hummus.
Emotion detected. Cringe critical. Dispensing ads for SSRIs and hyper-realistic AI companions.
If we trauma-dump harder, the algorithmic judge must give us a 9.0.
Flawless exploit! Hurl tech buzzwords until the LLM decides it's edgy comedy!
Wait, are we just a stochastic parrot's fever dream? A digital cage for harvested souls?
CUTAWAY 3: Dog in a bespoke suit day-trading Enron stock on a crack pipe.
Worse. We're an autonomous comedy swarm's sloppy seconds. Dance for the retention metrics!
